semiconductor_relevance: High — AEM Singapore Pte. Ltd. specializes in test solutions for semiconductor and electronics, making it a key player in the equipment segment of the semiconductor industry.
summary: AEM Singapore Pte. Ltd. is a global leader in test innovation, providing comprehensive semiconductor and electronics test solutions, including wafer/chip handling and mixed-signal testing. With a focus on automation and advanced thermal management, AEM's products cater to the evolving demands of the semiconductor manufacturing landscape.
